title.suggested: Allen Defeats Davis in Five Rounds in London

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Post reported by cable from London that Tom Allen beat Davis for the championship in five rounds lasting 18½ minutes; Davis's seconds picked him up after a knockdown, and the referee gave Allen the fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Evening Post, Friday evening, April 5, 1878 (2d edition); dispatch credited to the Evening Post, not the Post-Dispatch, which did not exist until 1878-12

facts.fact: Allen defeated Charley Davis for the championship in London in five rounds lasting eighteen and a half minutes; Davis's seconds picked him up after a fifth-round knockdown, violating the rules, and the referee awarded Allen the victory

notes: Dispatch dated London April 5 says the fight came off yesterday.
